Thin SVD reconstruction and zero-aware sigmaInv establish the four MP equations, uniqueness, zero and transpose identities for arbitrary finite rectangular matrices, including zero and empty dimensions. No full-rank premise is hidden in actual_isMP or uniqueness.

Full-row and full-column rational formulas require actual Gram determinant nonzero. Reverse-order multiplication retains C†C=I and RR†=I or their explicit Gram determinants. Range repair uses orthonormal Q, equality of actual ranges, and full-column rank of HtQ. Those hypotheses are not silently discharged or promoted to unconditional repair success.

The two earlier PseudoInverseMeasurable instances transport exactly the usual finite entrywise function-product measurable and Borel structures via inferInstanceAs. They do not replace the Gaussian sigma algebra with a trivial structure. The three global follow-on modules add no new Matrix measurable/Borel instances.

The actual SVD-selected map is the pointwise limit of Bᵀ(BBᵀ+t_j I)⁻¹ with t_j=1/(j+1)>0. Positive regularization gives true Gram invertibility for every rank. Each sigma/(sigma²+t_j) converges to the exact zero-aware reciprocal, treating sigma=0 separately. Finite sums yield entrywise convergence to the original map, and measurable limits give global Borel measurability. Arbitrarily selected singular bases are used only at fixed B, never assumed measurable as functions of B.

For d≤p, the Gram determinant is a nonzero polynomial on all d×p entry coordinates, witnessed by the rectangular identity. Nonzero Gaussian polynomial evaluations have null zero-set via finite root sets and product/Tonelli induction. This gives full-row rank AE for the actual independent Gaussian entries and transports to the original infinite GaussianLaw block. d=0 is valid with empty determinant1; d>p is not claimed.

For a fixed coisometry T with TT*=Id, characteristic functions transport actual standard Gaussian law to q dimensions, giving projected norm reciprocal moment1/(q−2) when q>2. The coisometry hypothesis and integrability dimension are explicit.

Gamma inverse moments retain shape>1 and rate>0. The full-row Frobenius²=trace inverse Gram identity is a conditional pointwise algebra identity. It is not an integrability theorem or a rectangular Gaussian inverse-Wishart moment.
